changes_made.description: Replaced all *TenantConfig references with TemplateSnapshot (value type) to match the type defined in internal/certificates/model.go.
Aligned GeneratePDF signature to GeneratePDF(cert *Certificate, snap TemplateSnapshot, verifyBaseURL string) matching the existing call site in handler.go:streamPDF.
Added Scope section: Backend (internal/certificates/pdf.go, go.mod), Frontend N/A, Database N/A, i18n N/A.
Added Out of Scope section: storing PDF to disk/object storage, multi-font Cyrillic/Kazakh beyond native capability, email delivery.
Added Test Strategy section covering: valid PDF magic bytes (AC-10), invalid base64 error (AC-9), empty logo fallback (AC-3).
Removed FR-BB43 from Depends On. Changed to 'none (requires only that Certificate and TemplateSnapshot types exist in the certificates package)' to break the circular dependency.
Replaced archived github.com/jung-kurt/gofpdf with github.com/go-pdf/fpdf (community successor, API-compatible). Updated all import references in code snippets.
Added library selection rationale note: go-pdf/fpdf chosen over unipdf (commercial licence) and wkhtmltopdf (system binary dependency).
Updated Description to state this requirement replaces the existing stub in internal/certificates/pdf.go.
Fixed unit test: replaced bytes.HasPrefix (does not exist) with string(b[:5]) == "%PDF-".
Fixed unit test: VerificationCode is type string — changed from uuid.MustParse(...) to plain string literal.
Expanded test skeleton to three separate test functions covering all three test strategy cases. Added signatory fields to implementation notes using snap.SignatoryName and snap.SignatoryTitle.
